basic_info.description: This beautifully renovated 2BD/1BA Russian Hill residence blends classic San Francisco elegance with contemporary comfort. Located in an exclusive six-unit building with a charming entry, dramatic staircase, and classic elevator, the home offers refined living in a premier location.  The gracious floor plan features a formal living room with a fireplace flanked by built-in bookcases, and a dining room that opens to gorgeous renovated kitchen with a versatile bonus area ideal for a home office or potential in-unit laundry.  The spacious primary bedroom includes a large closet with custom built-ins, while the second bedroom is perfect for guests. A stylish bathroom, hardwood floors, period moldings, and new windows enhance the home's timeless appeal.  Additional conveniences include easy access to a shared laundry room, private storage, and a secure videophone entry system.  Just steps from dog-friendly Alice Marble Park and minutes from tech shuttle stops and the vibrant Polk Street corridor, this residence offers the best of San Francisco living at your doorstep. This offering represents a 14.79% interest in 1310 & 1314 Greenwich Streetan extraordinary opportunity to own a refined piece of San Francisco history in one of the city's most iconic neighborhoods.
